summary.zh: 批量执行安卓屏幕操作，支持稳定节点引用
summary.en: Batch Android screen actions with stable node references

description.zh: 使用节点树查找控件，批量执行点击、输入、滑动和等待。节点引用过期时重新定位一次，连续操作无进展时及时返回。屏幕能力由 DeepDeep 提供。可选的坐标输入需通过宿主授权，默认关闭。
description.en: Find controls from the accessibility tree and run taps, text entry, swipes, and waits in a batch. The plugin retries stale references once and reports repeated lack of progress. Screen actions use the DeepDeep host. Optional coordinate input requires host authorization and is off by default.
